messages:
maya: FYI received $120,000 prepay from ACME under PO-9987 (invoice 2026-03-28, invoice #2026-055). Invoice splits into credits + support. Need deferral schedule for quarter close. tagging @sam @liam
sam: can you paste the invoice lines and any contract term? rough numbers are fine.
maya: sure — invoice snippet:
```
Line 1: ACME - Consumable credits - $100,000 - item_code: CR-ACME-100
Line 2: ACME - Premium support (12 months) - $20,000 - item_code: SUP-12
Invoice date: 2026-03-28
Terms: Non-refundable prepayment, credits expire 12 months
```
liam: looks like credits should be deferred. recognition depends on consumption pattern — typically we amortize credits as consumed; if consumption is lumpy and immaterial, ratable over 12 months. Support is recognized ratably over 12 months.
tony: quick Q — was there any bundled discount or promotional concession? allocation across performance obligations matters if yes.
maya: no discount on the invoice itself, but side email gives a one-time 10% onboarding credit. i'll attach that thread to the PBC.
legal-bot: contract clause 4.3 indicates prepaid credits expire at 12 months, non-refundable; performance obligation for credits is satisfied when credits are consumed. No explicit breakage estimate in contract.
sam: proposed cash receipt journal on 2026-03-28:
```
Dr Cash 120,000
Cr Deferred Revenue - Consumable Credits 100,000
Cr Deferred Revenue - Support 20,000
```
monthly recognition example (12-mo straight-line):
```
Dr Deferred Revenue - Consumable Credits 8,333
Dr Deferred Revenue - Support 1,667
Cr Revenue - Credits 8,333
Cr Revenue - Support 1,667
```
maya: i'll create a revenue schedule in NetSuite named AR-PREPAY-ACME-0326 and add monthly lines. who can sign off on the deferral period for close checklist? tagging @cecelia
cecelia: I can review and approve. confirm deferral period is 12 months starting invoice date 2026-03-28. include contract excerpt and the onboarding credit email in PBC. Also confirm breakage policy — if we had historical breakage data we could accelerate recognition, but you've confirmed no estimate, so do not recognize breakage early.
maya: confirmed — forfeiture at expiration, no breakage estimate. will include supporting docs.
liam: i'll update billing->GL mappings: consumable_credits -> deferred_rev_credits (account 2201), support -> deferred_rev_support (account 2202). will push CSV and tag invoice in billing system.
sam: i'll add the journal and schedule to the quarter close pack. if materiality questions come up i'll flag for controller review.
maya: one more operational note — because credits expire we should flag these customers in CRM for a usage nudging campaign. not part of month close but ops FYI.
liam: noted, opened a task in ops backlog.
maya: thanks all — i'll post NetSuite schedule link once created and move this to the close channel. :thumbsup:
